Ines once stayed late after a critical production outage, methodically isolating the root cause of a Kubernetes cluster failure. She didn’t just fix the immediate issue—she rewrote the deployment pipeline to prevent recurrence, blending AWS auto-scaling with Terraform modules. Her calm under pressure and knack for distilling complexity into actionable steps made her indispensable.  

Ines is a platform engineer who treats infrastructure as both art and algorithm. At HealthCloud, she led AWS cost optimization projects, slashing annual spend by 30% through spot instances and reserved instances. Her Terraform workflows streamlined multi-cloud migrations, and her GCP integrations reduced redundant data transfers by 25%. She thrives in ambiguity, translating business needs into technical roadmaps that balance innovation and fiscal responsibility.  

What sets Ines apart is her relentless curiosity and attention to detail. She once debugged a cascading failure across three regions by tracing a misconfigured IAM policy, then redesigned the access control architecture. Her mentorship of junior engineers—often during late-night Slack threads—has shaped a team culture of accountability. She balances technical rigor with empathy, ensuring systems are resilient *and* user-friendly.  

Ines is a rare blend of strategic thinking and hands-on execution. Her ability to navigate cloud ecosystems while maintaining cost discipline makes her a standout professional. I wholeheartedly recommend her for any role requiring both depth of technical expertise and the wisdom to prioritize impact over complexity.
